description.de: Die Herausforderung [challenge,162] abschließen und damit die Königlichen Gelees im Team in ihrem Dungeon besiegen.
description.en: Defeat the Royal Jellies in these bosses' dungeon as a team while completing the [challenge,162] challenge.
description.es: Vencer a las gelatinas reales en equipo en su mazmorra validando el reto [challenge,162].

description.pt: Derrotar as Gelatinas Reais em equipe em seu calabouço completando o desafio [challenge,162].
